name: Issyk-Kul Biosphere Reserve
story: Issyk-Kul Biosphere Reserve is located in eastern Kyrgyzstan and features Issyk-Kul Lake, an endorheic saline lake in the western Tian Shan mountains. Established in 1948 and covering the Issyk-Kul Region, the lake is fed by about 118 rivers, hot springs, and snow melt.
matters: The lake is a Ramsar site of globally significant biodiversity that supports large numbers of wintering waterfowl and endemic fish species, while forming part of the biosphere reserve established in the year 2000.
